At a Glance

Example School is a co-educational independent day school serving 500 students from Kindergarten through Grade 12. Founded in 1901, the school sits on a twelve-acre campus with dedicated lower, middle, and upper school buildings, a performing arts centre, and two gymnasiums.

  • Student-teacher ratio of 10:1 with an average class size of 16
  • Over forty student-led clubs and twenty competitive athletic teams
  • One hundred percent of graduates receive university offers
  • Need-based financial aid available at every grade level

Our mission is to nurture curiosity, integrity, and community in every student. Families are welcome to book a campus tour through the Admissions Office at any point in the school year.
